gloss: runner-up; next-highest score or vote count

definitions.gloss: runner-up; second place; next-highest vote count
definitions.explanation: The person or entry that came immediately after the winner. In elections it is the candidate with the next-highest vote total, who takes the seat if the winner has to step down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{次点|じてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: This time I ended up as the runner-up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当選者|とうせんしゃ}→当選者：26293_tousensha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{辞退|じたい}した→辞退する：18992_jitaisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{次点|じてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Because the winner declined, the runner-up candidate moved up.

examples.japanese: {応募作|おうぼさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、{次点|じてん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}される→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The standard of the entries was high, so the runner-up work was also published in the magazine.

notes:
{次|じ} (next) + ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (points, score) — literally the next score down.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {次点|じてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to end up runner-up
- {次点|じてん}⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧: the runner-up candidate
- {次点|じてん}⟦{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ→繰り上げる：07007_kuriageru⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧: winning a seat as runner-up after the winner withdraws

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{準優勝|じゅんゆうしょう}→準優勝：04910_junyuushou⟧: second place in a tournament — the standard sports term
- 2⟦{位|い}→〜位：00443_i⟧: second place — plain ranking, with no sense of "just missed it"

{次点|じてん} carries the flavor of having narrowly missed selection, so it is at home in elections, contests, and award judging rather than in sports standings.
